text.p: Results of International Cricket Council (ICC) Trophy matches on Tuesday:
United States beat Gibraltar by 189 runs
Scores: United States 312-6 in 50 overs; Gibraltar 123-9 in 50 overs
Kenya beat Singapore by two wickets
Scores: Singapore 89 all out in 44.4 overs; Kenya 90-8 in 30 overs
Bangladesh beat West Africa by nine wickets.
Scores: West Africa 82 all out in 39.1 overs; Bangladesh 83-1 19.4 overs
Scores: Malaysia 189 all out in 50 overs; Argentina 108 all out in 40.5 overs
Scores: Namibia 90 all out in 48.5 overs; Netherlands 91-0 in 23.5 overs
Canada beat Fiji by four wickets
Scores: Fiji 128 all out in 41.1 overs; Canada 130-6 in 38.2 overs
Scotland beat Papua New Guinea by six wickets
Scores: Papua New Guinea 120 all out in 36.1 overs; Scotland 121-4 in 38.1 overs
Hong Kong beat Bermuda by three wickets
Scores: Bermuda 227-9 in 50 overs; Hong Kong 228-7 in 49.4 overs
